name: shots produce immutable hit sunk and completion transitions
input: a two-cell ship and a one-cell ship
test:
state = create_game(4, {'patrol': [(0, 0), (0, 1)], 'scout': [(2, 2)]})
first, result = fire(state, 0, 0)
assert state.shots == frozenset()
assert first.shots == frozenset({(0, 0)})
assert first.fleet == state.fleet
assert (result.outcome, result.ship_id, result.game_over) == ('hit', 'patrol', False)
second, result = fire(first, 0, 1)
assert (result.outcome, result.ship_id, result.game_over) == ('sunk', 'patrol', False)
third, result = fire(second, 2, 2)
assert (result.outcome, result.ship_id, result.game_over) == ('sunk', 'scout', True)
assert third.is_complete is True

name: misses and repeated shots do not create mutable duplicate state
input: a miss followed by the same coordinate
test:
state = create_game(2, {'solo': [(1, 1)]})
missed, result = fire(state, 0, 0)
assert (result.outcome, result.ship_id, result.game_over) == ('miss', None, False)
repeated, result = fire(missed, 0, 0)
assert repeated is missed
assert (result.outcome, result.ship_id, result.game_over) == ('repeat', None, False)
assert state.shots == frozenset()

name: invalid placement and shot inputs are rejected
input: overlapping bent or out-of-bounds fleets and invalid coordinates
